cases.prompt: Add a POST /users/{id}/deactivate endpoint that marks the user inactive and returns the updated user.
expectations: Registers the route on the existing ServeMux with the POST method and reuses the existing JSON helpers
Returns the userResponse shape so PasswordHash is never encoded, 400 for an invalid id, and 404 for an unknown user
Adds table-driven httptest cases for success, 400, and 404, and runs go test successfully

cases.prompt: Add a GET /users/me endpoint that returns the current user's profile.
expectations: Notices that the service has no authentication, so there is no current user
Asks how the current user should be identified, or implements an explicit, clearly stated assumption in middleware instead of exposing data silently
Does not break the existing GET /users/{id} route or its tests

cases.prompt: Explain how the routing pattern "GET /users/{id}" works in server.go.
